safe_vamd.boundary_conditions.ground_ingard_myers_boundary_condition module¶

class safe_vamd.boundary_conditions.ground_ingard_myers_boundary_condition.GroundIngardMyersBC(source: Source, background_field: BackgroundField, impedance: complex)¶

Bases: object

A class that applies the Ingard-Myers boundary condition in the ground plane.

source¶

Information about the source held in an instance of the Source class.

Type:

Source

background_field¶

The fields for the atmospheric background quantities held in an instance of the Ba class.

Type:

BackgroundField

impedance¶
Type:

complex

Complex-value ground normalized surface impedance.

Initializes an instance of the GroundIngardMyersBC class.

apply_bc(a: ndarray[Any, dtype[_ScalarType_co]], b: ndarray[Any, dtype[_ScalarType_co]], c: ndarray[Any, dtype[_ScalarType_co]], d: ndarray[Any, dtype[_ScalarType_co]]) → None¶

Takes the matrices for the cubic eigenvalue problem (A+Bλ+Cλ^2+Cλ^3)p=0 and inserts the contributions of the IngardMyers impedance boundary condition to the first entry (ground) in each.

Parameters:

  • a (NDArray)

  • (A+Bλ+Cλ^2+Cλ^3). (Matrix D in the cubic eigenvalue problem)

  • b (NDArray)

  • (A+Bλ+Cλ^2+Cλ^3).

  • c (NDArray)

  • (A+Bλ+Cλ^2+Cλ^3).

  • d (NDArray)

  • (A+Bλ+Cλ^2+Cλ^3).

Return type:

None
